home.title: Welcome to my portfolio!
home.intro: My name is Vitalii, and I am a Frontend developer who creates modern, intuitive, and aesthetic interfaces.
home.description: I combine technical knowledge with creative vision to develop web applications that not only look good but also function quickly and efficiently.
home.focus: My focus is on developing responsive SPA (single-page applications), API integration, theme support (light/dark), custom UI components, and multilingual support (i18n). In my projects, I actively use React, TypeScript, SCSS, Git, and other modern technologies.
home.website_description: This website is more than just an online business card. It's a demonstration of my skills, attention to detail, and approach to user experience. Every section, every animation, every project reflects my style as a developer.
